# Awesome AI Agent Governance

> A curated list of tools, frameworks, standards, and resources for governing autonomous AI agents

Awesome AI Agent Governance is a community-curated list of tools, frameworks, standards, and research for governing autonomous AI agents. It covers policy engines, audit and assurance frameworks, agent identity and attestation, risk assessment, observability, and deployment guidance. Maintained by AgenTrust alongside the TRACE, Agent Manifest, cMCP and cA2A open standards.

## The list

- [List](https://governance.agentrust-io.com/index.md)
